raw_input.projection: actual-coordinate trapezoidal NUDFT per wavelength and order
raw_input.sampling_invariance: no raw pointwise comparison; independent of Nx/Ny when coordinates represent the same field
raw_input.local_medium: construct basis independently at each plane from the plane material/index and periodicity
raw_input.maxwell_constraint: six-component least-squares fit to TE/TM E and H basis vectors
raw_input.evanescent: retain complex coefficients and metadata; never assign propagating power

normalization_and_gauge.gauge: one deterministic global phase per wavelength from the incident channel, reused at all planes/channels

metric.threshold: inherited frozen gate; this comparator does not change admission thresholds

reuse_map.m2q_directional_projection_recovery_v2: reuse synthetic/axis concepts only; Air-only scalar sentinel and finite-source assumptions are not canonical
reuse_map.pw_scientific_launcher: reuse lifecycle and R/T/order output; former Ex/Hy scalar amplitude is not the primary state
reuse_map.r3_r4_outputs: historical diagnostics only; not authority for coherent C_PW
reuse_map.this_comparator: single canonical implementation for truth extraction, saved-state comparison, and future ML labels

fast_policy: FAST remains REJECTED by its frozen R/order gate regardless of corrected complex-state recomputation
future_admission: MEDIUM_PW may not enter until this schema is produced and the existing admission gates pass
